documents.title: Advanced Perspectives on Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines
documents.content:
Title: Advanced Perspectives on Continuous Benchmark Evaluation for Enterprise Retrieval Pipelines
Authors: Quang Le, Yen Vu
Published: 2025-06-12
Categories: Evaluation Methodology, Enterprise Systems
Summary: An extended empirical study on tatic benchmarks fail to capture domain drift in enterprise knowledge bases. We establish a synthetic test generator that auto-creates paired evaluation sets whenever new corpora are ingested Further analysis on scaling parameters.

documents.content:
Title: Advanc
Authors: Dat Tran, Lan Pham
Published: 2026-06-11
Categories: Information Retrieval, Algorithms
Summary: An extended empirical study on ense vector search excels at conceptual similarity but struggles with exact acronyms and serial numbers. Reciprocal Rank Fusion of sparse lexical scores and dense embeddings achieves optimal recall Further analysis on scaling parameters.

documents.title: Advanced Perspectives on Automated Data Quality Profiling with Great Expectations in CI/CD
documents.content:
Title: Advanced Perspectives on Automated Data Quality Profiling with Great Expectations in CI/CD
Authors: Son Nguyen, Thuy Doan
Published: 2025-06-10
Categories: Data Quality, DevOps
Summary: An extended empirical study on mbedding quality checks directly into data pipelines enables fail-closed governance. We show how Great Expectations suites catch schema drifts and null fields before documents reach the embedding model Further analysis on scaling parameters.

documents.content:
Title: Advanced Perspectives on Semantic Layer Integration for Agentic Text-to-SQL Pipelines
Authors: Huy Dinh, Trang Vo
Published: 2025-06-06
Categories: Databases, Information Systems
Summary: An extended empirical study on onnecting LLMs directly to raw warehouse tables often results in schema misunderstandings. A governed semantic layer standardizes business metric definitions, dramatically boosting SQL generation accuracy Further analysis on scaling parameters.
